CustomField.description: The canonical PII field type code this record resolves to - must match one of the AIAssistApplicationConstants.PII_FIELD_TYPE_* values. Kept separate from the record's own label so the label can be edited freely without breaking the code's matching.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The PII type this record resolves to, e.g. "Email" or "Bank Account". Must match a value the code recognizes.
CustomField.label: PII Field Type
